metadata.author: JaZeR
metadata.description: Genre-aware presets for Frequency Shifter effect

trap-riser.name: Trap Riser Shift
trap-riser.workflow: Automate frequency shift from 0 to 800Hz over 4-8 bars for riser builds. Use in pre-drop sections.

troubleshooting.tooHarsh: Reduce mix to 50%, add high-pass at 400Hz
troubleshooting.NotBuilding: Increase shift range, automate over longer period

hip-hop-wobble.name: Wobble Bass Shift
hip-hop-wobble.workflow: Apply to 808 bass and automate LFO to control frequency shift. Sync LFO to half-note or quarter-note for rhythmic wobble effect.

a/bTesting.testA: Low frequency shift with feedback for dubby feel

rb-flange.name: Soul Flange
rb-flange.workflow: Use on lead vocals or synths for subtle movement. Low frequency shift creates gentle flanging without harshness.

a/bTesting.testA: Lower shift amount for subtle effect
a/bTesting.testB: Higher shift for more obvious character

troubleshooting.tooObvious: Reduce mix to 20%, decrease shift to 30Hz

edm-metallic.name: EDM Metallic Shift
edm-metallic.workflow: Apply to percussion or synths for metallic textures. High shift with feedback creates sci-fi metallic sounds.

a/bTesting.testA: High feedback for resonant metallic tone

troubleshooting.NotMetallic: Increase feedback to 55%, increase shift to 500Hz

lofi-wobble.name: VHS Warble
lofi-wobble.workflow: Use on drums or full mix for lo-fi degradation effect. Slow LFO modulation creates warbling tape effect.

troubleshooting.tooSlow: Increase LFO rate for faster wobble
troubleshooting.tooFast: Reduce LFO rate for gentle warble

drill-sub.name: Grim Sub Shift
drill-sub.workflow: Apply to sub bass for dark, grimy texture. Subtle shift creates harmonic distortion without losing sub weight.

a/bTesting.testB: Upward shift for more aggressive character

troubleshooting.losingSub: Increase pre high-pass to 40Hz, reduce shift to 150Hz

experimental-space.name: Cosmic Shift
experimental-space.workflow: Use on pads, FX, or processed vocals for otherworldly effects. Alternate direction creates random frequency jumps.

a/bTesting.testA: High frequency shift for dramatic effect
a/bTesting.testB: Lower shift for more subtle enhancement

troubleshooting.tooChaotic: Reduce mix to 40%, decrease feedback to 30%

dub-wobble.name: Dub Shift Echo
dub-wobble.workflow: Combine with delay for classic dub effects. The frequency shift interacts with echoes for unique texture.

synth-texture.name: Texture Enhancer
synth-texture.workflow: Use on synth leads to add harmonic complexity without obvious effect. Low mix keeps enhancement subtle.

vocal-widener.name: Vocal Air
vocal-widener.workflow: Apply to lead vocals to add subtle
and presence. Very low frequency shift prevents phasing while adding clarity.

troubleshooting.causingPhasing: Reduce mix to 20%, decrease shift to 30Hz
